confidence_notes: Meals, coffee and beer draw on a June 2026 snapshot from [Numbeo](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Rome). Cocktail and wine estimates use its [November restaurant-menu aggregates](https://www.numbeo.com/restaurant-prices/in/Rome) as proxies for July. Accommodation figures are holistic estimates and vary with location and booking date.
comparable_city_reasoning: Rome is treated as a major Southern European tourist city, broadly comparable to Florence and Barcelona, with July demand factored into accommodation estimates.
